commit f775bc20ef536b3e0db221f8fe97e15ea7f8c377
ordinal 88
date 2026-08-07 23:21:57 -0700
author Matt Stults
subject Three verified defects fixed, and an audit's open findings landed
⭐ (a) `link._check_clingo`'s return-code arm was UNPINNED — the arm that
catches "clingo never ran". Mutating `if errs or r.returncode not in
CLINGO_OK_RC:` to `if errs:` survived all 352 tests and `--self-test` 19/19.
With clingo absent the output is "No module named clingo", `CLINGO_ERR` matches
ZERO of it, and the finding comes from the return code alone — so under the
mutant a program that never compiled reports clean. No code change: the guard
was already right, only untested. Two tests added, both RED-verified (the
`if errs:` mutant fails one, an `if True:` mutant fails the other). The test
scripts a fake interpreter rather than relying on a python that happens to lack
clingo, and asserts its own premise, so installing clingo cannot silently
switch it off.

⭐ (b) `abstained_under_repair` was counted as TRANSLATED in the run summary.
`n_ab` matched `status == "abstained"` exactly and the translated count was the
residual, so a clause the model refused after two failed attempts printed as a
success — in the one line a human reads. The same defect was fixed in
`run.json` and missed one line below, because the test that closed it asserts
on the stored field. Now counts `translated` by name, prints both abstention
kinds, and warns on any status it does not partition on. Pinned on the PRINTED
LINE. `README.md`'s status list corrected.

⭐ (c) The cost estimate UNDER-stated the worst case by 12.7% at the shipped
`repair.max_attempts: 3` — re-derived independently before changing anything
(7.0% at 2, 12.7% at 3, 17.5% at 4, 21.4% at 5). `estimate_cost` grew input
triangularly but only over `system + user`; the transcript's largest component,
the prior completions (up to `max_tokens`, ~12x the user block), was never
billed. `README.md` and `config.json` BOTH asserted the estimate was
conservative, so a reader checking it was told the error could not exist — on a
project with a hard $8.50 ceiling. Now adds `(k-1) * max_tokens` per attempt k.
The over-charge on the user block is deliberately KEPT: high is survivable, low
is not, and the two must not be netted off.

Audit findings landed (each re-verified against the code first, not
transcribed): DEBUGGING_TIPS.md §2 / §7 / §8 appends and new §13 (`acts` is not
a declaration site) and §14 (the cost estimate); DEFERRED.md D-4 (`world`
toggleability is a comment, not a switch), a D-1 bullet (weakest-licence
inheritance is stated and unbuilt) and a D-3 sentence (`concept-multi-gloss` is
structurally incapable of firing); phase_1/README.md (the stale `translate.py`
docstring/banner, five known unpinned edges).

⛔ Everything whose destination is `resources/03_pipeline.md` is NOT landed —
that file is watched with another change in flight. Collected in REVIEW_QUEUE.md
§8 for a single later edit, with current line numbers.

REVIEW_QUEUE.md §1 and §2.2 were stale and are corrected: the bad-worked-example
item was ruled, restored as bad example #6, then REMOVED again after two failed
measurements. It is a null result on a weak instrument, explicitly not a
blocklist.

DECISION_stage3_build.md's `discrimination = 7/9` for m0255 now records its
invocation. It is 7/9 WITH the linked clauses and 4/9 for the module alone.

Suite: 352 -> 359 for these changes (other agents have since added more). No
test weakened, deleted or xfailed. No --accept, no --live, no spend, no push.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

----END----

commit 3759e55441cba7258402898d24ccf05f39c67581
ordinal 90
date 2026-08-07 23:22:50 -0700
author Matt Stults
subject stage 4: the renderer is total, and the restrictions it justified are withdrawn
RULING (Matt, 2026-08-07): no restrictions on the ASP for rendering. The point
of the implementation is to let the model represent section logic without new
code for every new concept.

schema.py
  * REMOVED `_check_body`'s anonymous-variable rejection. Its whole stated
    ground was "the tool that renders a rule back into English cannot process
    it". Disproved twice: [RAN] clingo derives p(a) from `p(X) :- q(X,_).
    q(a,b).`; and ASP2CNL renders `_` by skipping hidden terms
    (`assignment(_,blue)` -> "an assignment with color equal to blue",
    CEUR Vol-4117 short_rcra_3.pdf, read in full). A body binds its own
    variables, so there is no safety ground either.
  * KEPT `_check_term`'s rejection, REGROUNDED. The brief asked for both to go.
    [RAN] says otherwise: every slot `_check_term` guards renders into a rule
    HEAD, and `_` in a head is unsafe whatever the body binds --
    `q(a). p(_) :- q(X).` -> "unsafe variables in:" and clingo refuses the whole
    file. The message now states the solver's ground, not the renderer's.
  * `_strip_strings` deleted (dead with the guard it served).
  * Audited and KEPT on independent grounds, each named in the report:
    unsafe-variable, BEHAVIOUR_NS, RESERVED, _TERM narrowness, read_back
    `_BAD_IN_TEXT`, body newline, body trailing full stop.

test_schema.py / mutate_schema.py
  * `test_an_anonymous_variable_in_a_BODY` deleted with its guard; the ALSO
    mutation `_check_body / anonymous variable` deleted with it.
  * The term-slot test is kept, renamed to say HEAD, and its comment now
    carries the clingo run instead of "failure mode 7".
  * NEW positive control: `_` in a body validates, renders and CLINGO LOADS the
    .lp -- so restoring the deleted guard breaks something.
  * mutation: 44 guards, 44 killed, 0 survivors, 0 errors (was 45/45/0).
    Not a lowered floor: one guard withdrawn on a disproved ground, its safety
    half still pinned, and the newly permitted case pinned positively.

STEP_stage4.md -> revision 2, §2.3 only
  * Two layers. Layer 1 is a total `clingo.ast` fallback -- `str(node)` is
    defined on every node, so a rendering always exists; [RAN] 12/12 constructs
    (aggregates, conditional literals, comparisons, intervals, pooling, choice,
    weak constraints, nested functions, `_`) with no node-type introspection.
    Layer 2 is the old template table, now OPTIONAL: missing template -> layer
    1, never an error.
  * Every rendering stamps `layer: 1|2`; layer-1 fraction printed even at zero.
    Precedent: RB4's `non-evidential` stamp -- stamp, don't fail.
  * ASP2CNL recorded as the reference for template shapes, with its NAMING
    MODEL rejected by name: it verbalises predicate and attribute NAMES, and
    Invariant 1 requires the definition, not the label -- adopting it would
    manufacture failure mode #4 inside the renderer, where no seat can see it.
  * Its round-trip through CNL2ASP recorded as SPECULATIVE and not a
    dependency, and weaker than the brief assumed: the paper claims round-trip
    only for PENGASP, and only for rules PENGASP itself produced.
  * `readback-ungloss` survives = MISSING GLOSS, never a missing template; the
    two are now separated in prose and in test row 7b.
  * §8 gains rows 7b, 23-26.

⚠️ NOT DONE, and reported rather than patched:
  * `translate.py --self-test` now 51 passed / 2 failed. The new failure is its
    own `check("an anonymous variable in a rule body", ...)`, which asserts the
    guard this commit removed. translate.py is another agent's file; the fix is
    to delete that one `check(...)` call.
  * prompt/00_task.md rule 7 and prompt/30_failure_modes.md mode 7 still tell
    the model `_` breaks the explainer. Reported with recommendations, not
    edited: they are watched transcriptions, mode 7 is numbered and mirrored in
    three eval_arms copies, and DEBUGGING_TIPS §10 wants a held-out measurement
    for a prompt change.

Suite: 467 passed (walkthrough/). guard.py: schema.py needs re-acceptance.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

----END----
